title: Introduction to asg4nbashots
text: asg4nbashots package provides cleaned NBA shot-level dataset (1997–2020) helper functions quick exploration visualisation, along bundled Shiny app interactive analysis. allows users : Explore millions NBA shot attempts distance, zone, season type Summarise accuracy expected points trends Launch interactive app deeper exploration

title: Introduction to asg4nbashots
text: ’s compute shot accuracy year zone using built-helper function. can also manually create quick summary dplyr:
code: shot_zone_summary() library(dplyr) library(lubridate)  nba_shots |>   mutate(year = year(game_date)) |>   group_by(year) |>   summarise(     attempts = n(),     made = sum(shot_made_flag),     accuracy = made / attempts,     .groups = "drop"   )

what: Accuracy and expected points by distance
title: Introduction to asg4nbashots
code: library(ggplot2)  summary_df <- nba_shots |>   group_by(shot_distance) |>   summarise(     accuracy = mean(shot_made_flag),     expected_points = mean(shot_type * shot_made_flag),     .groups = "drop"   )  ggplot(summary_df, aes(shot_distance)) +   geom_point(aes(y = accuracy), color = "steelblue") +   geom_point(aes(y = expected_points), color = "red") +   labs(     title = "Accuracy and Expected Points by Distance",     x = "Distance (ft)",     y = "Average Accuracy / Expected Points"   ) +   theme_minimal()

title: Introduction to asg4nbashots
text: can also look field-goal accuracy court zone season type.
code: nba_shots |>   group_by(season_type, shot_zone_basic) |>   summarise(     attempts = n(),     made = sum(shot_made_flag),     accuracy = made / attempts,     .groups = "drop"   ) |>   ggplot(aes(x = shot_zone_basic, y = accuracy, fill = season_type)) +   geom_col(position = "dodge") +   coord_flip() +   labs(     title = "Shot Accuracy by Zone and Season Type",     x = "Shot Zone (Basic)",     y = "Accuracy"   ) +   theme_minimal() [chunk-end]

what: Example: Accuracy and Expected Points by Distance
title: NBA Shot Data 1997–2020 Explorer
text: example illustrates calculate two common performance metrics: Accuracy — percentage made shots distance Expected points — average points scored per attempt, based shot success shot type (2- 3-point)  blue points represent average shot accuracy distance, red points show expected points per attempt — capturing value longer shots 3-pointers become frequent.
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: 'dplyr' #> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from 'package:base': #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(ggplot2)  # Compute accuracy and expected points by distance summary_df <- nba_shots %>%   group_by(shot_distance) %>%   summarise(     accuracy = mean(shot_made_flag),     expected_points = mean(shot_type * shot_made_flag),     .groups = "drop"   )  # Plot both metrics ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = shot_distance)) +   geom_point(aes(y = accuracy), color = "steelblue") +   geom_point(aes(y = expected_points), color = "red") +   labs(     title = "Accuracy and Expected Points by Distance",     x = "Shot Distance (feet)",     y = "Average Accuracy / Expected Points"   ) +   theme_minimal()

title: NBA Shot Locations, 1997–2020 (Extended) — nba_shots
text: dataset containing 4.7 million NBA shot attempts 1997 2020. Includes shot distance, court zones, shot type (2 3 points), outcome information, suitable statistical visual exploration.

title: NBA Shot Locations, 1997–2020 (Extended) — nba_shots
text: tibble 4,729,512 rows 11 variables: action_type factor — specific shot action (e.g., Jump Shot, Layup, Dunk). shot_distance integer — distance shot attempt, feet. shot_zone_basic factor — broad zone classification (e.g., Restricted Area, Mid-Range, Left Corner 3). shot_zone_area factor — general court area (e.g., Left Side (L), Center (C), Right Side (R)). shot_zone_range factor — distance category (e.g., Less 8 ft., 8–16 ft., 16–24 ft., 24+ ft.). x_location integer — x-coordinate shot location court. y_location integer — y-coordinate shot location court. shot_type integer — numeric value shot: 2 3 points. shot_made_flag integer — 1 shot made, 0 missed. game_date Date — date game YYYY-MM-DD format. season_type factor — season category (e.g., Regular Season, Playoffs).

title: NBA Shot Locations, 1997–2020 (Extended) — nba_shots
text: Original data adapted “2020 - June - NBA Shots (1997-2019)" available https://data.world/sportsvizsunday/june-2020-nba-shots-1997-2019, cleaned processed data-raw/nba_shots.R.
